headline: The proposed listings cover the route and permission details I need before choosing a stop with my suitcase.
nice_to_have: Include a clearly labeled example showing restroom floor, stairs, purchase requirements, and the observation date together so I can see how quickly I could check them.
in_character_reaction: Tell me what floor the bathroom is on, whether I have to take stairs, and whether I need a purchase or a key. This proposal covers those questions and makes clear that getting into the building does not mean I can use the bathroom. Showing when elevator information was observed would help me decide whether to chance that stop.
